sources.title: PAYE employment plus additional income
sources.excerpt: Being taxed under PAYE does not automatically mean you have no Self Assessment obligations. Additional untaxed income, self-employment, property income or other criteria can still mean you need to file a return. Check GOV.UK ‘who must send a tax return’.

sources.title: Trading allowance overview
sources.excerpt: The trading allowance is a tax exemption of up to £1,000 a year for individuals with trading income from self-employment, casual services or hiring personal equipment, subject to conditions. If annual gross trading income is £1,000 or less you may not need to tell HMRC (with exceptions). Confirm eligibility on GOV.UK before relying on it.

sources.title: Property allowance overview
sources.excerpt: The property allowance is a tax exemption of up to £1,000 a year for individuals with income from land or property, subject to conditions and interactions with other reliefs (including Rent a Room). If annual gross property income is £1,000 or less you may not need to tell HMRC (with exceptions). Confirm eligibility on GOV.UK before relying on it.
